$comment: Phase 1 baseline load profile (ADR-028, OPS-86, QA-124). This is a development/CI regression gate on the reference environment — NOT a production capacity claim. The reference environment is the machine the run executes on (recorded in every report: CPU model and count, total memory, runtime version, PostgreSQL version). Production capacity targets are per-deployment measurements in the same shape.

phase1Scope.note: Login, map-data, and SOS-creation routes join the profile in the phases that create them (Phase 2/3/5). SSE/WebSocket event rate is 0 until the Relation Service ships streams (Phase 4); the gate asserts the stream surface does not exist yet.
